versions.changelog:
Initial release of "ice-dam-defense" skill.

- Provides guidance on sidewalk/driveway de-icing: which salt works at what pavement temperature, correct dosage, refreeze warnings, and pet/concrete/plant safety.
- Diagnoses roof ice-dam risk: attic heat-leak scoring, snow-load calculation, urgency assessment, and safe dam removal and leak response steps.
- Includes quick-reference tables for de-icer properties and common pitfalls in winter maintenance.
- Example commands and safety notes supplied.
- References real chemistry and building science—clear limitations and use cases are explained.
